title: Citymapper Route Trip Duration Leaderboard
dataSources: ADS-B aircraft snapshots (`adsb:aircraft`), personal flight logbook (`flight:log`), commute trips (`commute:trip`), transit arrivals (`transit:arrival`), geofence events (`geofence:event`), travel documents (`travel:document`), fare quotes (`airprice:quote`).
app: Home ADS-B receiver (dump1090/readsb/tar1090 JSON feed), personal flight logbook exports, commute/transit APIs, and phone geofence webhooks via Splunk HEC.
spl:
index=personal sourcetype=citymapper:route duration_min=*
| stats sum(duration_min) as total_value, avg(duration_min) as avg_value by mode
| sort - total_value
description: Ranks mode values by total and average trip duration across Citymapper route events.
value: Leaderboards help you see which people, devices, places, or projects dominate the signal.
implementation: Ingest numeric `duration_min` values for each Citymapper route event and review total and average trip duration by mode.
visualization: Table of entities ranked by total trip duration.
grandmaExplanation: It simply which mode shows the biggest trip duration numbers in your Citymapper route data.
